registryBasis: The official Purulia district land-records page directs users to Banglarbhumi and identifies the Director of Land Records and Survey; the official Banglarbhumi page lists Plot Map, Mouza Map, RS-LR and related land-record services. This establishes the West Bengal state/district revenue land-record custodian and service route, but not open parcel geometry or complete city coverage.

officialSources.observation: Purulia district government page describes land-record administration, links Banglarbhumi, and names the Director of Land Records and Survey.
Official West Bengal land-record page lists public service routes including RS-LR Plot Information, Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request, and Mouza Map Availability Details.
West Bengal government department page identifies the web-based e-Bhuchitra/Banglarbhumi land-record system and public access role.

source.name: West Bengal Banglarbhumi / Directorate of Land Records and Survey
source.operator: Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department, Government of West Bengal; Directorate of Land Records and Survey; Purulia district administration
source.method: Separate English and Bengali first-party discovery, followed by bounded anonymous HTTPS GET attempts to the official portal and current service page inspection through published page evidence
source.scope: Purulia district/state land-record service custody evidenced; no verified open parcel geometry for Purulia city.

remainingUncertainty: The current portal JavaScript/configuration, parcel layer schema, CRS, stable native identity, city boundary coverage, and anonymous geometry access remain unresolved because the official hosts timed out. A timeout is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No synthetic identity or raw source attributes were retained. Packet completion is not source integration/admission; independent serial reviewer qualification remains required.
